description: Raw events, newest first, under simple filters: event names, one user (distinctId), page search, property filters or a VinktarQL WHERE expression. Use it to see what one user did, or to inspect real payloads. Pass `eventId` instead to get that one event in full, every column and the whole payload. Windows longer than 30 days are narrowed to their last 30. For counts, use query_trends or run_sql instead of paging.

distinctId.description: One person: matches user_id, distinct_id or device_id exactly.

eventId.description: One event in full, by the event_id a listing or run_sql returned. Every other argument is ignored.

expression.description: A VinktarQL boolean expression, e.g. "properties.plan = 'pro' AND country = 'DE'".

filters.description: Each {key, op, value}: key is a column (country, page_path, release…) or "properties.<key>"; op EQ, NEQ, CONTAINS, NOT_CONTAINS, GT, LT, GTE, LTE.

last.description: Relative window ending now, e.g. "1h", "24h", "7d", "30d", "90d". Default "14d". Ignored when `from` is given.

project.description: Project handle (as in list_projects) or id. Optional when this connection is limited to one project or the workspace has only one.

projects.description: Project handles (as in list_projects) or ids, to read across several apps. Leave out for every project this connection can reach. For one project use `project`; never pass both.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring of page_path or page_url.

name: browse_events
title: Browse events
